admissibility.reason: Selected engineering seeds and repeated ticks are not fresh independent draws from a declared task distribution. Continuation/replay agreement measures identity, not task loss.
admissibility.source_binding_check_scope: Compact row identity and recorded action/normalized-state digests only; no new raw-runtime validation.

planning.decision: Conditional go for a new small plumbing pilot after freezing actual policy adapters and the sampling/asset path; no-go for claiming certified improvement from existing campaign or running a large certification campaign now.

formulas.assumptions: Fixed candidate family and baseline; fixed target distribution and bounded whole-scenario loss; fresh independent scenario draws (or validated conditional MGF); no audit-driven prior/family/scale change.

planning.interpretation: These are worst-case confidence radii, not observed effects, power calculations, or guarantees of certification. Improvement requires an observed upper endpoint strictly below zero. Two-sided intervals must split alpha between tails. The fixed-horizon radius is not valid for arbitrary early stopping.

scope: Planning arithmetic and compact recorded-metadata consistency; no new task execution or statistical certificate.
